laneGates.generated-file-removal: Disabled: measured candidate Invalidated by a missed first-cancel drain deadline
laneGates.unforced-git-worktree-removal: Disabled: worker-owned proof strategy Invalidated when an admitted descendant outlived its proof handles; clean-command compatibility observation remains Partial

serverOwnedProof.proofId: opaque, expiring and single-use where execution is authorized
serverOwnedProof.policyGeneration: expected generation; changes refuse before affecting blocked objects
serverOwnedProof.parameters: validated server-owned snapshot; never a client replacement manifest

supervision.beforeMutation: newly owned native process container, verified suspended child membership before resume
supervision.namedCollision: refuse before changing limits, spawning or terminating members
supervision.firstStop: start one monotonic drain deadline immediately on first cancellation, stop or operation-budget request
supervision.deadlineMiss: strategy Invalidated; operation interrupted; preserve uncertainty separately
supervision.afterDeadlineMiss: retain supervision; terminate only verified owned container; observe original process handles signaled and all members exited
supervision.unknownExit: retain authority, supervision and fixtures; no successor mutator or teardown
supervision.release: only after independent terminal observations; no PID-age assumption

operationResults.complete: actual requested work finished under a validated proof
operationResults.refused: no destructive work authorized or started; reason retained
operationResults.partial: actual completed work and remaining restrictions recorded
operationResults.interrupted: execution did not settle normally; unknown deletion counts remain unknown

adoptionGate: All required deterministic, real-actor, policy, resource and lifetime cases plus independent review for the exact lane; downstream ownership requirements remain separate
